- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The local cuisine in Jaffna is known for its unique flavors and spice blends.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular seafood dishes found in Jaffna include:
  1. Jaffna Crab Curry - A spicy curry made with fresh crab meat cooked in a blend of aromatic spices.
  2. Fish Puttu - Grated fish mixed with grated coconut and steamed.
  3. Prawn Masala - Prawns cooked in a spicy tomato-based sauce with onions and garlic.
  4. Cuttlefish Fry - Cuttlefish marinated in spices and fried until crispy.
  5. Fish Curry - Fresh fish fillets cooked in a thick curry sauce.
  6. Fish Kool - A traditional Jaffna fish stew made with various seafood.
  7. Squid Curry - Squid cooked in a spicy curry sauce with onions, tomatoes, and coconut milk.
  8. Fish Pittu - A steamed dish made with grated fish, coconut, and red rice flour.
  9. Fish Vadai - Deep-fried balls made with ground fish, onions, and spices.
  10. Spicy Prawn Fry - Prawns marinated in spices and fried until crispy.
